address: 2F, Raffles, Galaxy, Estrada da Baía de Nossa Senhora da Esperança, Cotai, Macau
bio: The first overseas outpost of the legendary Hokkaido establishment, Sushi Miyakawa is open for dinner only with an omakase menu comprised of 10 Edomae-style sushi, appetisers, miso soup and dessert items. Three types of rice from Hokkaido and Akita prefectures are dressed in a blend of three red vinegars and are perfectly paired with the freshest seasonal catch, mostly from Hokkaido. With only 10 counter seats and one room, reservations are recommended....
